label: GO step where the agent chooses a2
explanation: Fires only on GO steps (100% of activation mass; essentially never on D1 or D2). At GO it fires on 97% of steps where the policy argmax is a2, and its magnitude follows how strongly a2 is preferred: activation correlates about 0.95 with a strongly negative choice logit (logit(a1)-logit(a2)). Every step in the bottom bin (choice < -8.9) is active, and the third and fourth activation quartiles are about 100% covered by the predicate. Misses carry only 4.6% of the mass. They are weak activations (mostly < 0.3 of max) on a1 choices, usually in an a2-leaning context or when the preference for a1 is weak. Not driven by reward, transition type, stay/switch or the reached state beyond their correlation with choosing a2. Recorded model_act (the agent own computed choice at GO); the realized action gives the same F1 (0.888 dev).

issues: The claims hold up. On dev, GO carries 100% of the activation mass. D1 has 54 active steps out of 380k and D2 has 0. On test, the predicate scores P 0.967, R 0.822, F1 0.889 and mass recall 0.954, matching the report. The predicate covers 100% of the 3rd and 4th activation quartiles.

Recall by count is only 0.82. The misses are about 45k test steps, but they hold just 4.6% of the mass. They are a weak, low-level firing on a1 GO steps. They rise with position in the episode: on a1 GO steps the feature is active 15-18% of the time at ep_bucket 3-4 and 32% at ep_bucket 5 (trials 50-99), but always at low magnitude (mass 2.9%). Across runs of repeated a1 choices the activation creeps up slowly (e.g. 0.32 -> 0.37). This is a small baseline drift, not a separate meaning.

The weak a1 firing is concentrated where the a1 preference is weak. On GO & model_act==1 & choice<3, 61% of steps are active, versus 25% overall. This supports reading the feature as a graded 'a2-preference' feature rather than a strict on/off for the a2 choice. A threshold on the logit (GO & choice < 2) does marginally better, with test F1 0.897 and mass recall 0.964.
Adding prev_action==2 (GO & (model_act==2 | prev_action==2)) gives test F1 0.889, no gain. Keeping the simpler predicate is justified.
False positives (about 7k, P 0.967) are scattered. They are slightly more common early in the episode: precision is 0.906 at ep_bucket<=3. No systematic class was found.
